source_notes: Génesis Energías chartered the 2004-built, 138,000 m3 LNG carrier 'Bilbao Knutsen' (owned by Norway's Knutsen Group) to serve as the floating storage unit (FSU) for the Puerto Cortés LNG-to-power project. HD Hyundai Marine Solution converted the vessel to an FSU; the FSU arrived at Puerto Cortés in Sept 2025. Vessel owner = 'Knutsen Group' (specific subsidiary not disclosed in sources — see qa). GEM unit had no FloatingVesselName; this fills a verified blank, no value conflict.
scope_note: FSRU sync touchpoint: vessel-name fill (FSU). Vessel identity/specs are owned by the carrier project per the FSRU sync rule; flag for cross-check. RR note (10/25) had deferred vessel fields pending clarity on the Knutsen-Group owner — now FSU vessel name is confirmed.
